install.title: Install the app
install.description: Add PropManager to your home screen to open it like an app.

ios.title: Install on iPhone
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
ios.step3: Tap Add. PropManager now opens from your home screen.
ios.openInSafari: Open this page in Safari to install the app. Browsers inside other apps, like WhatsApp or Instagram, can't add it to your home screen.
